name: The Little Black Bestiary: A Midsummer Night’s Barcrawl
source:
Once upon a time, a lonely human office worker was browsing their favorite dating website, when they received a surprise invitation from Miss Amaryllis Alstroemeria, a cunning fae businesswoman with a reputation for innovation... and a love of mischief. As such, they were only given a scant 15 minutes to prepare for a night of merriment, libation and perhaps even some carnal affection. Or shall this night take a different, stranger turn? Do you have what it takes to impress a beautiful, ruthless and astoundingly wealthy fairy? Find out in The Little Black Bestiary: A Midsummer Night's Barcrawl.

A Midsummer Night's Barcrawl is an erotic modern fairy tale set in a world where humans live side-by-side with all manner of monsters and fantasy races. Choose one of two protagonists, a human male or female, (The latter making this into a lesbian dating game) play through several minigames as you scramble to prepare for your impromptu date, get to know Amaryllis and a variety of other colorful characters as you get to see a side of society you barely know anything about, and of course, if all goes well then this fairy tale may very well get a 'happy ending.' Euphemism fully intentional. But even if things go badly, some of the other potential outcomes for the night might be interesting as well...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1621130/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
从前，一位孤独的人类上班族正在浏览自己最爱的交友网站，突然收到了一份来自阿玛莉莉丝·阿尔斯特罗梅利亚小姐的惊喜邀约——她是一位精明狡黠的妖精女商人，以敢于创新……以及酷爱恶作剧而闻名。正因如此，主角只有短短15分钟的时间，去为这场充满欢笑、美酒乃至鱼水之欢的夜晚做准备。又或者，这个夜晚会走向截然不同、更加离奇的展开？你是否有本事打动这位美貌、冷酷而又富可敌国的妖精？快到《The Little Black Bestiary: A Midsummer Night's Barcrawl》中一探究竟吧。

《A Midsummer Night's Barcrawl》是一部背景设定在人类与各色魔物及奇幻种族比邻而居的世界中的成人现代童话。你可以从人类男性或女性两位主角中任选其一（选择后者将使本作变为女同性恋约会游戏），在手忙脚乱准备临时约会的过程中游玩数个小游戏，结识阿玛莉莉丝以及形形色色性格鲜明的角色，一窥这个社会你几乎一无所知的另一面。当然，如果一切顺利，这则童话故事很可能会迎来一个“快乐结局”——这里的双关完全是故意的。不过就算搞砸了，今晚其他几种潜在的结局或许也同样妙趣横生……
